Aircraft launch and recovery officers do more than give signals on a flight deck. They direct catapult launches and arrested landings, monitor deck and weather conditions, coordinate ground and flight crews, execute emergency procedures through split-second judgment, and debrief safety. The role has almost no tolerance for error.
